name: Canadian Rural Routes, Post Office Boxes and General Delivery
description: Rural routes, site and compartment, general delivery (poste restante), and post office boxes with stations (succursales) and retail postal outlets. Rural routes report rr and ruralRoute; general delivery and site cases are partial where a part has no field yet. Shapes follow Canada Post's Addressing Guidelines, described in our own words; every input is constructed for this corpus, and no table is copied from Canada Post.
